finding: The source demonstrates a rule-driven reclassification, not an independent discovery of truth.
basis: Pages 23-25 define F_004 to invalidate T_002, apply the chosen metrics, then treat the resulting status transition as validation.
required_action: Implement as a hypothesis; compare against pre-declared expected outputs and controls.

finding: The reported 0.98 coherence score is not reproducible from the source record.
basis: Page 29 reports the score without formula, denominator, dataset, baseline, uncertainty, or independent scoring.
required_action: Keep “reported / unverified”; exclude it from efficacy claims.

finding: T_001 combines several outcomes and governance forms into one broad hypothesis.
basis: Page 19 says distributed ownership/collective decisions show higher resilience and lower Gini. External evidence is narrower and mixed for firm-performance/survival outcomes.
required_action: Split into measurable outcomes and pre-register separate hypotheses.

finding: T_002 is framed as an implausibly strong universal position.
basis: Page 20 calls unconstrained deregulation/privatisation the “only reliable” path. No supporting source is given.
required_action: Keep quote; add a “steelman” reconstruction and matched empirical claims.

finding: F_004 combines ethical purpose and empirical causality in one universal statement.
basis: Page 23 uses “all” strategies and “net destructive”; the transcript supplies no underlying quantitative evidence.
required_action: Decompose into sector-specific claims, define externalities and test counterfactuals.

finding: AURA metrics cannot yet act as quantitative gates.
basis: Pages 9-10 show example thresholds; pages 23-24 provide verbal judgements but no formulas or input data.
required_action: Specify constructs/formulas/units and test reliability, validity, calibration and gaming first.

finding: DEEP/Eco-Linked Assets are a proposal in this record, not a verified external standard.
basis: Pages 26-27 provide a name and description but no retrievable primary source in the cited passage. Established UN SEEA EA offers a better-grounded comparison.
required_action: Treat DEEP as a project label; map differences against SEEA EA and existing NZ tools.

finding: Coherence must not be treated as truth or legitimate policy authority.
basis: Removing a contradiction can raise a coherence score without improving empirical validity, fairness or outcomes.
required_action: Three separate dimensions: evidence quality, logical consistency, and value legitimacy.

finding: Existing policy frameworks are key baselines, not obstacles to novelty.
basis: NZ Treasury LSF/CBAx, Stats NZ environmental-economic accounts to 2024, and UN SEEA EA already provide relevant wellbeing, cost-benefit, trade-off, and ecological-accounting baselines.
required_action: Define what CASCADE or DEEP adds beyond them, and for whom; quantify the gap.

finding: The original PDF is not safe to call anonymous as-is.
basis: Pages 29-30 and other pages include identifying attribution/context despite anonymity language.
required_action: Create a separately reviewed redacted derivative if public anonymity is required.
